title: Circle
subtitle: Round, and greedy with space
description: A circle, good for a focal quest and poor for a dense tree: the corners of its square are outside it, so two circles side by side waste the space between them.

It is the shape that shows why the icon's fit cannot be one constant. A circle needs an inset of about `size/2 * (1 - 1/sqrt(2))` before a square fits inside it -- 7 pixels at 48, against the rounded rectangle's 4.
